parameters.query:
with user_ctx as (
    select u.id as user_id
    from moneytrack.app_users u
    where u.telegram_user_id = {{ $json.telegram_user_id }}::bigint
    limit 1
),

target_tx as (
    select
        t.id,
        t.description,
        t.amount_original,
        t.currency_original,
        t.transaction_date
    from moneytrack.transactions t
    join user_ctx uc on uc.user_id = t.user_id
    where t.id = {{ $json.transaction_id }}::bigint
),

deleted_receipt_items as (
    delete from moneytrack.receipt_items ri
    using moneytrack.receipts r, target_tx tx
    where ri.receipt_id = r.id
      and r.transaction_id = tx.id
    returning ri.id
),

deleted_receipts as (
    delete from moneytrack.receipts r
    using target_tx tx
    where r.transaction_id = tx.id
    returning r.id
),

deleted_tx as (
    delete from moneytrack.transactions t
    using target_tx tx
    where t.id = tx.id
    returning
        t.id,
        t.description,
        t.amount_original,
        t.currency_original,
        t.transaction_date
)

select
    exists(select 1 from user_ctx) as user_found,
    exists(select 1 from deleted_tx) as deleted,
    (select id from deleted_tx limit 1) as id,
    (select description from deleted_tx limit 1) as description,
    (select amount_original from deleted_tx limit 1) as amount_original,
    (select currency_original from deleted_tx limit 1) as currency_original,
    (select transaction_date from deleted_tx limit 1) as transaction_date;
